mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark FROM sys_role r
mapper.select: INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status = '0' ORDER BY r.data_scope ASC, r.role_sort ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id WHERE r.del_flag = '0'
AND r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roleName}, '%')
AND r.role_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roleKey}, '%')
AND r.status = #{status}
${params.dataScope} ORDER BY r.role_sort ASC, r.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET role_name = #{roleName}, role_key = #{roleKey}, role_sort = #{roleSort}, data_scope = #{dataScope}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
